Business rules

6 rules in 2 areas, written as sentences. A rule is a condition the code insists on.

The snapshot does not record whether a rule is proved or checked at run time, so every status reads Unknown. The explorer shows a status as soon as the snapshot carries one; it never guesses.

  • ProvedThe verifier proved that this rule always holds.
  • Checked at run timeNot proved; the program checks the rule while it runs and stops when it is broken.
  • OpenNeither proved nor checked: nothing makes sure the rule holds.
  • UnknownThe snapshot does not say whether this rule is proved or checked.
